entries.name: Gearthorn

counterPressure.note: The only raw-stat line on this weapon is atom.might at trivial band; every real number it carries is the atom.cleansing rider. A slot the pool would normally fill with a stat stick instead does one narrow thing well: scrub the wielder's own status ailments mid-fight.

entries.flavor: Somewhere under the gear teeth, a vine still grows toward the light. The bellows just decided the vine's sap made a better coolant than water ever did.
entries.notes: armament-primary/utility row. baseType item.plant-muzzle-a-009 ('Spraying Bellows', class nozzle) is grepped verbatim from data/seed/items/base-types/plant-armament-primary-a.json, not derived from the role name. Name is a whole-token fusion from uniqueSetSeedPools['thorned-chassis'] (canonicalId 'gearthorn'), used atomically per naming.v1.json rule 2a; unused by any set or charm in this theme (sets/thorned-chassis.json used 'junkbramble' and 'ironstem', charms used neither). atom.cleansing (status.clear) is legal to fix here even though it sits on mantle's implicit slate, not armament-primary's: a unique's fixed core is never drawn from the role-filtered affix pool (seed-contract.md's fixed-core mechanism, same reasoning as unique.exemplar.json's rung-2 break), and atom.cleansing itself binds today (not stat.derived, not quarantined). powerAxis 'utility' matches the actual effect rather than the role's conventional identity, which is the point of a unique per ssot-uniques.md #3.5.

entries.name: Ledger of Salvage

counterPressure.note: A real authored negative atom, not a disclaimer: atom.vitality low with params.sign=negative, the same negative-atom mechanism data/seed/items/charms/econ.json's charm.econ-019 already uses to pair a strong economy line with a weakened survivability one. The torso's padding was pawned for capital; the coin line is real, the thinner hp pool is real too.

entries.flavor: Every dent it takes gets a line entry. The apron stopped being armor around the fourth ledger page.
entries.notes: core-guard/economy row. baseType item.humanoid-torso-a-004 ('Secondhand Apron') grepped from data/seed/items/base-types/humanoid-core-guard-a.json. Of-construct name: invented ordinary base noun 'Ledger' (an authored, unregistered noun, the same pattern set.thorned-chassis-001 used for 'Yoke' and set.thorned-chassis-004 used for 'Cordon') plus concept 'salvage' from conceptPools['thorned-chassis']; 'salvage' is unused by any thorned-chassis set or charm entry to date. atom.midas is legal for jewel-major/girdle's implicit slates, not core-guard's; fixed here as an off-role identity pick, same license as the unique.exemplar.json worked example. Both fixedAtoms are Flat/Increased stat-channel families (midas is resource.economy Flat-shaped, vitality is primaryChannel Flat) - no More-op family, no defense-channel family.

entries.name: Bolted Bramble

counterPressure.note: The shield half is deliberately thin (low band) - this sheath is not built to stall a fight, only to make the one hit it does absorb hurt the attacker back. All of its identity sits in the retribution rider, none of it in raw mitigation.

entries.flavor: The bolts hold the plating on. The thorns underneath were never anybody's idea but the plant's.
entries.notes: ward-array/offense row. baseType item.plant-sheath-a-009 ('Warped Casing') grepped from data/seed/items/base-types/plant-ward-array-a.json. Compound name: adjective 'Bolted' from themeAdjectivePools['thorned-chassis'] (previously paired only with 'Sprig' in charms/off-ctrl.json's charm.off-ctrl-012 - a different noun, so this pairing does not collide) plus invented ordinary noun 'Bramble'. atom.warded is ward-array's own legal implicit family (classes.v1.json implicitSlates.ward-array), so the shield half is in-role; atom.retribution is armament-secondary's family, fixed here off-role for the offense signature, same fixed-core license as elsewhere in this file. Both families are shipped and bindable today (warded is shield.grant, not one of the three quarantined shield stat.derived families).

entries.name: Muffler of the Linkage

counterPressure.note: Both fixed atoms are stat.modify survivability lines and nothing else - no attack rider, no utility hook, no economy hook. A jewel-major slot usually buys a build's signature move; this one only buys staying alive, which is the deliberately small slice of the build problem it solves.

entries.flavor: Chain-linked and choked tight, it does one thing without complaint: it keeps the wearer walking after the fight most collars would have ended at.
entries.notes: jewel-major/survivability row. baseType item.humanoid-neck-a-008 ('Punched Muffler') grepped from data/seed/items/base-types/humanoid-jewel-major-a.json; 'Muffler' is that same file's own nounPools['jewel-major.humanoid'] entry, reused here as the of-construct base per naming.v1.json's 'any nounPools entry' allowance for uniques. Concept 'linkage' from conceptPools['thorned-chassis'], unused elsewhere in this theme's sets/charms. Both fixedAtoms (vitality, fortitude) are jewel-major's own legal implicit families (classes.v1.json), so this entry stays fully in-role, unlike the others in this file.

entries.name: Wired Glume

counterPressure.note: The raw stat line is trivial-band. A sense slot would ordinarily buy accuracy or crit; this one spends its whole budget on the sporing control rider instead, and offers nothing else.

entries.flavor: Somebody ran a copper lead into the husk to see what it would do. It answered by learning to aim.
entries.notes: sense/control row. baseType item.plant-bract-a-006 ('Layered Bracteole') grepped from data/seed/items/base-types/plant-bract-a.json. Compound name: adjective 'Wired' from themeAdjectivePools['thorned-chassis'] (unused elsewhere in this theme's sets/charms) plus noun 'Glume' from nounPools['sense.plant'] (the same file's own pool). atom.sporing is infusion's legal family, fixed here off-role for the control signature; it is a fully shipped status.apply family, not one of the Unity-CC-branch-blocked ones (embering/scalding/entangling). Tagged combat-posture 'offensive' rather than 'utility', matching this corpus's own precedent for axis:'control' charms (data/seed/items/charms/off-ctrl.json tags every control-axis entry 'offensive').

entries.name: Cogcreeper

counterPressure.note: The personal stat line is trivial-band; the entire point of this boot is the gardener rider, which is why it reads as a support tool rather than a footspeed upgrade.

entries.flavor: It leaves two kinds of tracks: bootprints, and whatever took root three steps behind them.
entries.notes: footing/utility row. baseType item.humanoid-feet-a-009 ('Oiled Cleat') grepped from data/seed/items/base-types/footing/humanoid/a.json. Name is a whole-token fusion from uniqueSetSeedPools['thorned-chassis'] (canonicalId 'cogcreeper'), used atomically; unused by any set or charm in this theme. atom.gardener (spawn.entity) is retinue's legal family, fixed here off-role for the utility signature; per classes.v1.json's retinue note it is standalone-safe (works both on the lawn and in battle), so this is not a runtime-pending pick. Same precedent as data/seed/items/charms/surv-util.json's charm.surv-util-008, which tags an axis:'utility' atom.gardener entry 'utility'.

entries.name: Resin of the Engine

counterPressure.note: The venomous rider is trivial-band and exists only so the item still reads as an infusion gland at all; every meaningful number on it is the sunbloom economy line.

entries.flavor: The gland still makes poison, out of habit. What actually pays the bills is what it makes instead.
entries.notes: infusion/economy row. baseType item.plant-glands-a-007 ('Slender Resin') grepped from data/seed/items/base-types/infusion/plant/a.json; 'Resin' reuses that same file's own head noun. Of-construct name: Base 'Resin' plus concept 'engine' from conceptPools['thorned-chassis'], unused elsewhere in this theme's sets/charms (sets used 'chassis' and 'overhaul'; charms used neither). atom.sunbloom is girdle's legal family, fixed here off-role for the economy signature; atom.venomous is infusion's own legal family, kept in-role at trivial band as the flavour tether. Both are fully shipped resource.economy / status.apply families.

entries.name: Spiked Megaphone

counterPressure.note: The wearer's own ferocity line is trivial-band; virtually all of this item's offense comes from what the summoner rider calls in, not from the wearer's own swing.

entries.flavor: One blast and something answers. Nobody who built it ever confirmed whether it was calling for help or ordering an attack, but by the third blast it stopped mattering.
entries.notes: retinue/offense row. baseType item.humanoid-horn-a-007 ('Twisted Horn') grepped from data/seed/items/base-types/retinue/humanoid/a.json. Compound name: adjective 'Spiked' from themeAdjectivePools['thorned-chassis'] (unused elsewhere in this theme's sets/charms) plus noun 'Megaphone' from that same file's nounPools['retinue.humanoid']. atom.summoner is retinue's own legal implicit family (classes.v1.json), standalone-safe per that role's note, so this entry stays fully in-role; powerAxis is 'offense' rather than the role's usual 'board presence' framing because a summoned attacker reads as damage output, matching this partition's assigned (role, axis) allocation.
